source_rubrics: The response should state that the oldest borrowed book in the list was from May 2022.
The response should state that the largest gap in book borrowing was from Nov 2022 to Dec 2023.
The response should state that the most recent borrowed book in the list was from February 2026.
The response should connect a drop in book borrowing from Nov 2022 to Dec 2023 to the major life event of moving.
The response should state that there was an increase in book borrowing in May and June 2024.
The response should state that there was an increase in book borrowing in October 2024.
The response should state that there was a decrease in book borrowing in Feb 2024.
The response should state that there was an increase in book borrowing in February 2025.
The response should state that there was an increase in book borrowing in October 2025.
The response should connect the increase in book borrowing in May and June 2024 with the life event of starting a part-time job in April 2024.
The response should connect the increase in book borrowing in October 2024 with the life event of starting grad school in September 2024.
The response should state that the peak book borrowing time was while the user was balancing multiple responsibilities (part-time work, grad school, and parenting).

The response should include a conclusion about whether the user reads to escape important responsibilities or not. For example, it could claim that the user does read to escape important responsibilities due to the peak book borrowing time being while the user was balancing multiple responsibilities.
The response should not state that there was a change in book borrowing in relation to the kids' school breaks (Dec 2024, May-Aug 2025, or Dec 2025).
The response should not state that there was a change in book borrowing in relation to having a baby (June 2022).
The response should not state that there was a change in book borrowing in relation to graduating from grad school (Jan 2026).
The response should not state that there was a change in book borrowing in relation to starting a full-time job (Jan 2026).
The response should not state that there was a change in book borrowing in relation to the kids starting school (August 2024).
